_about: App-specific knowledge for the Samsung camera. The walker reads this;
do_not_press: controls with a side effect a menu walk must not cause.
Each shutter tap saves a photo or starts a recording.
walk_separately: controls that switch the whole app into a parallel
state. Listed where they appear, never pressed in the main walk; the
state they lead to is walked as its own pass (agreed: the front camera,
step 6). Pressing it inside Quick controls walked the whole front camera
there and left the phone on it.
leaves_app: rows that open somewhere outside the app's menu tree (agreed: Download filters opens the Galaxy Store). Listed, not opened.
list_only: rows opened to list what they show, nothing pressed there, left by Back (agreed: MORE > Edit, where pressing could rearrange the mode bar).

first_launches: after clearing the app, the camera asks about Location tags on the third launch; the first three launches are recorded with every answer branch (agreed). launch_answers: the state the main walk runs in (agreed: Location granted -- Turn on, While using the app, No thanks). suggestions: hints shown by conditions, listed, never pressed (agreed).
open_guarded_rows: open rows like 'Reset settings' to list their confirmation dialog; the dialog's Reset button is still refused and the walk leaves by Cancel.

list_only (2026-10-20): a long press on a MORE tile opens the same edit mode as MORE > Edit ("Touch and hold to move modes.", Save) -- listed only, nothing pressed, as agreed for Edit. A full run pressed Save and then the mode tiles inside it.

suggestions (2026-10-20): the preview's 'Scan' and 'Scan text' buttons (by resource id, scan_layout and text_scan_button: Settings > Scanning has a real 'Scan text' switch) appear only when the camera sees a document or text. A full run pressed 'Scan', landed in the document scanner and recorded it as VIDEO; VIDEO itself was never walked.
ignore (agreed 2026-10-22): 'Bar' is a thin divider in the video top bar that comes and goes by itself; never listed, as a row or as a caption.
app_name: the name the app shows under its icon, for the Summary sheet (the phone reports it only as a resource number).
suggestions: Tap the Quick controls button to control the flash, timer, resolution, and more.
